digest.component_or_area: capability enforcement and optional dependency management
propositions: A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must validate that each of 14 initial capability records maps to exactly one declared packaging extra and one typed missing posture without importing its probe module.
Stable commands and top-level help must remain accessible in a no-extras wheel, with only the selected capability boundary emitting an actionable error for error-posture capabilities.
Lean diagnostic and read-only modes must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities, such as audit show without audit_ui or non-agent review workflows without agent_runtime.
Unavailable, abstain, and fallback capabilities must preserve existing domain output shapes, exception types, and exit contracts rather than having the registry manufacture results.
Separate entry points mcp_server and review_bot must consume capability metadata and remain absent from the CLI route registry.
